entry_thesis: The book is flat. AUDCAD at 0.9879 is the 95th percentile of five-year history, z-score 2.25, while WTI is 102.78 and December Brent is 115.32. That is a Canada-versus-Australia peer dislocation with a live oil terms-of-trade tailwind, not a screen that merely fell. Cash AONIA 4.60 versus CORRA 2.24 still leaves Australia 236bp ahead, and March CORRA already prices 78.5bp of hikes through the 2.75 midpoint, so leftover Canada policy cheapness is not the remaining gap. US 10-year 5.05 is the 98th five-year percentile, but the hawkish hold, oil, and 99th-percentile asset-manager longs make a from-flat receive crowded. Short AUDCAD. Real effective exchange rates are not in the freeze.

events.rationale: Short 25 million AUDCAD at the 95th five-year percentile while WTI 102.78 and December Brent 115.32 favor CAD versus AUD; March CORRA is already through the 2.75 midpoint so leftover Canada policy cheapness is not the trade.

invalidation: Cover if AUDCAD prints a new five-year extreme while WTI remains near 102.78, or if March CORRA implied falls toward cash 2.24 with oil unchanged, which would mean Canada policy is easing into the oil impulse instead of the cross paying the terms of trade. A widening AONIA-CORRA cash gap on a still-easy Canada overnight rate also kills the convergence.
